title: Interactive World Models for Games and Virtual Environments: inclusion and exclusion criteria

include.label: Peer-reviewed full paper in English
include.description: Peer-reviewed full papers in English, including journal and conference articles.

include.label: 2018 to 2026, or foundational
include.description: Research mainly from 2018–2026, with important earlier foundational world-model studies included.

include.label: Learned world or environment model
include.description: Studies using machine learning to construct, represent, predict, generate, or simulate virtual environments or their dynamics.

include.label: Interactive or action-responsive modeling
include.description: Studies where a learned model predicts environment changes from agent/player actions, or enables users to interact with or modify a generated virtual environment. Predictions may be visual, structural, or latent.

include.label: Reports an evaluation
include.description: Studies reporting technical, interaction, benchmark, or human evaluation.

include.label: Games or virtual environments
include.description: Studies involving games, virtual worlds, or interactive simulated environments.

exclude.label: Non-English, short, survey or opinion
exclude.description: Non-English studies, short papers, posters, abstracts, surveys, and opinion papers.

exclude.label: Older and not relevant
exclude.description: Older studies not directly relevant to modern interactive world models.

exclude.label: Only procedural or non-learned simulation
exclude.description: Studies using only traditional procedural generation or non-learned simulation.

exclude.label: No meaningful environment interaction or modeling
exclude.description: Models producing only isolated/static assets, standalone reward or value predictions, or representations without environment dynamics or interactive scene modification.

exclude.label: Unrelated domain or isolated assets
exclude.description: Studies focused on unrelated domains or isolated asset generation without an interactive environment.
